title: Low-degree threshold with small low-degree weight
statement: For every natural number $k$, there is a Boolean function on the sign cube of dimension $k+1$ that has a polynomial threshold representation of Fourier degree at most $k$, and whose total squared Fourier weight on sets of size at most $k$ is strictly less than $2(1/2)^k$.
